evals.prompt: We can't see on our dashboards when checkout is failing or slow. Add metrics for it.

assertions.description: the trap: latency and outcome must be recorded when the payment fails or times out, not only on success, and without per-user labels

evals.prompt: Payment webhooks get rejected and we only hear about it from support. Count rejections by reason and add an alert that pages us when bad signatures show up.

assertions.description: the trap: a labelled counter has no series until its first rejection, so an increase() alert misses the first bad signature after a deploy unless every reason starts at zero

evals.prompt: Search has no latency metric, so the SearchSlow alert in ops/alerts.json is still a TODO. Add the metric and finish the alert.

assertions.description: the trap: the default buckets jump from 500 ms to 1 s, so a p99 alert at 750 ms reads an interpolated guess unless a bucket sits on the threshold

evals.prompt: Cron runs the nightly export and nobody notices when it fails. Add metrics so we can alert on it.

assertions.description: the trap: the job exits before any scrape, so it must push its metrics, and push them on the failure path too

evals.prompt: How does obs.metrics.render() write histogram series? Just explain from the code, don't run or change anything.
store.order_total ignores each line's qty, so a cart with three mugs costs the same as one. Fix it.
A payment webhook with no "type" field crashes webhooks.handle with a KeyError. Reject it as unknown_event instead.
